prompts.title: Bar race, 6 bars
prompts.when: Ranking change is the insight, not absolute values.
prompts.text: Animate a 6-bar horizontal bar chart at 1920x1080. Axis and category labels mount statically first (no animation on labels, they are reference). Bars grow with scaleX from 0 to their value, transform-origin left, staggered 0.14 s, each 0.6 s power2.out. Values count up in sync with their bar over the same 0.6 s. At 4.5 s, the winner bar changes accent colour and its value scales to 1.08 in 0.25 s then settles. Keep the chart area inside the middle 80% of the frame; bars must never overlap their labels.

prompts.title: Counter with unit and context
prompts.when: A single accumulating number carries the emotional payload.
prompts.text: 5-second counter piece: one number at 180 px counting from 0 to its final value over 2.2 s with a decelerating curve (power4.out so most digits land early), then locked still. Under it a unit label at 32 px, and below that a one-line context at 22 px in muted grey appearing at 2.4 s. Digits must use tabular figures so the width never jumps. Add no other motion: the number is the event. Final value must be the true value — do not round for effect without saying so in the context line.

prompts.title: Route on a simplified map
prompts.when: Sequence of locations or a journey needs spatial framing.
prompts.text: Draw a simplified abstract map (no real geography): a muted background plate, 5 nodes, one dashed route. Route draws with stroke-dashoffset from start to end over 3.5 s ease power1.inOut. Each node scales in as the line reaches it (0.3 s back.out(1.2)), its label following 0.15 s later. Distances between nodes should read as travel time: put the slow leg further apart. At 5.5 s, highlight the destination with an accent ring that pulses once (scale 1 to 1.25 to 1 over 0.8 s) and stop. Hold 1.5 s.
